name: start
title: network.start
lead: Starts an instance of `member`. Answers at once; it is online later.
signature: network.start(options: {member: string, label: string, slots: number, data: any }) → (NetworkStarted ?, string ?)

params.name: options
params.type: {member: string , label: string , slots: number , data: any }

usedIn.quote: - `network.start{ member, label, slots, data? }` starts an instance of `member`. It returns `{id, state}` at once, with `state = "starting"`: the instance comes online later. `slots` is the number of players the instance takes. `data` is the pack's own value for the instance, read there with `network.info()`.
